author: Katy_Ph
title: Do not download
body:
They simply can't protect your data, even with two-factor authentication. I've been hacked literally three times in just a few days, and I had ALL the account protection methods enabled. Support won't transfer you to a human being, but instead advises you to calm down and try LOGGING INTO YOUR ACCOUNT AGAIN. By the way, deleting it doesn't help, it still grants access to someone else.
Please check before registering, there's a whole thread online about how business accounts in Indonesia are registered using numbers from people in other countries. THIS IS NOT NORMAL, I DON'T FEEL SAFE. Someone else can regain access to my account at any time and do whatever they want.

Hello WhatsApp Team,

Feature Request: Temporary Chat Tab with Anti-Screenshot

The Idea:
Add a "Temporary Tab" inside any chat for text messages only. 
1. All messages auto-delete for both sides when the tab is closed.
2. Block screenshots and screen recording inside this tab. If someone tries, show a black screen and notify the other person.
3. Messages should not be saved in chat history or backups.

Why:
For sharing sensitive info with extra privacy. 
Currently "Disappearing Messages" deletes all chat, and "View Once" is only for media.

Thank you for considering this.

author: huhhhftyff
title: Can’t log in, No Human support from the app just AI response
body: I have been unable to use WhatsApp for several days due to an account registration issue that started unexpectedly. My account was initially restricted for “unusual activity,” so I submitted a review as instructed. The review was completed and WhatsApp allowed me to log in again, but since then I have been stuck in a continuous login loop. When I log in, my previous chats briefly appear, then “Connecting…” appears and I am immediately logged out again with the message that my phone number is no longer registered with WhatsApp on this phone. I have tried everything suggested by WhatsApp Support, including updating the app, restarting my iPhone, switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data, using a VPN, trying WhatsApp Web, and even offloading and reinstalling the app. Nothing has worked. The most frustrating part is that WhatsApp Support keeps providing automated/AI responses that repeat generic troubleshooting steps instead of actually investigating the account. I have already provided screenshots and explained the issue multiple times, yet I still cannot access my account. Please have a real technical support representative investigate this issue and restore access to my WhatsApp account. I have been without WhatsApp for days, and this is extremely frustrating for an essential communication app. still acter 3 updates my issue stand unresolved.

author: W1ldfl0w3rs
title: Please have an actual person look at my case
body:
I have been using the same WhatsApp number, and my account has been banned three separate times, despite me doing nothing that violated WhatsApp’s rules. Each time, I submitted a review and my account was restored.

After the third restoration, however, I suddenly stopped receiving WhatsApp verification codes. My SIM is active and works perfectly: I can make and receive calls and receive both local and international SMS. I have tried different networks, mobile data, another device, the official updated app, and waited several days between attempts.

Now WhatsApp tells me:

“Login not available right now. For security reasons, we can’t log you in right now.”

I contacted support hoping they could actually investigate what is happening. Instead, I have been given the same generic troubleshooting instructions repeatedly—check my SIM, change networks, use a VPN, use a proxy, or request a ban review.

I HAVE ALREADY DONE THESE THINGS. My account was already reviewed and restored. I am not asking how to appeal a ban. I am asking why WhatsApp is preventing me from logging back into an account that you already restored.

The automated support system does not understand the situation and has no way to escalate it to someone who can actually look at my account.

I have important conversations and information on this account, and I have been locked out because of what appears to be an automated security system that nobody at WhatsApp is willing or able to investigate.

Please have a human support agent look into this. I don’t need another generic troubleshooting checklist. I need my account investigated and my ability to verify my number restored.

title: Too many inconsistencies.

Yes it’s for free, but the features are very limited. 

Unable to delete previous sent messages to recipients thus won’t be available after two days onwards, this tool will be disabled and no other options are there to protect your privacy when you send messages to organisations or to other personal data through other contacts. 

Be wary, to always make sure to select “delete all messages for everyone” before the two days timer, avoid the aggression.

After also reinstalling WhatsApp and seeing how slow incoming messaging process is to reappear or haven’t appeared at all should be logged in for review/update.

There should be also a deleted “bins” section where deleted / removed may need to retrieve old contacts or messages afterwards, as this should’ve been an existed relevant feature already for WhatsApp.

author: Kapapakon
title: Looping problem
body:
I am extremely frustrated with this issue. My account has been blocked for two days, and I have received no clear explanation as to why.

The biggest problem is that the app seems to be stuck in an endless verification loop. Every time I complete the re-verification process, I receive a message saying that my account can now be used. However, instead of giving me access, the app immediately redirects me back to the beginning of the verification process. This happens over and over again, making it impossible to access my account.

There is no explanation of what the actual problem is, no error message, and no alternative way to verify my identity or contact support through the app. It genuinely feels like there is a bug or technical glitch preventing the verification process from completing successfully.

I have tried multiple times over the past two days, but nothing has changed. I am now completely locked out of my account with no way to resolve the issue on my own.

Please investigate this issue as soon as possible and provide a solution. This experience has been incredibly frustrating, and I urgently need access to my account.

author: Disappoint And Hopeless
title: Utterly Disappointed With This App
body:
My screen suddenly told me that “Your Account Has Been Banned.  This Account Can No Longer Use WhatsApp”.  All messages could no longer be read.  It stated that messages could still be read.  No they couldn’t.  The option to request a review was available.  I clicked this.  It told me that I could wait 24hrs before the account would either be reinstated or continued to be banned.  

My actions have all been honourable.  I only use it to speak to my family, friends, work related messages and the street WhatsApp group and read news feeds.

Eventually the account was reinstated however NO previous messages were available.

I had messages from deceased members of my family and friends.  These are now not available.  There were messages I need to refer back to for work and friends and family.  My backups were mysteriously were unavailable- my own profile was reset. 

Appalling - I hadn’t downloaded many of the images and sent to me - gone forever.

Beware, even your backups are gone 😢😳😕

author: stuffe
title: AI Account Reviews removed my account
body: WhatsApp is great, but today I opened my phone to see that my account was banned.  That’s it, after 15+ years, banned with no reason given.  There is an appeal button, I pressed it and tried to point out I use my account like a normal person for family and friends, the appeal was rejected *instantly* by email, and now that’s it.  Once your appeal is rejected you can NEVER use WhatsApp on that phone number again.  I ran my life on WhatsApp, social stuff, clubs, even work here and there.  But because AI decided something that I will never be told about was against their terms of service, and because their AI account review decided in seconds that they hadn’t made a mistake, I now have weeks of trying to contact everyone who will now see that my account seemingly exists, messages get sent, and delivered, but they will never ever be read.  If I could use any other app I would, but sadly as mentioned I used it so heavily, I have no choice but to change my phone number.  BECAUSE OF AI.  Absolutely disgraceful way to treat customers.

author: DestinyJo
title: What’s happening?
body: I run my business on Facebook through a group and lately they’re making it impossible for us. I’ve spent so much money on ads to grow it. First I stopped getting notifications of comments on album pictures. I thought ok, I’ll tell my customers to like them as well so I get notified, and I can check my feed from time to time to see what pops up with the comments. Then it stopped kicking the pictures to the feed and just kicking the whole album up to the top. Now even my like notifications are failing. How am I supposed to run a business if I can’t see the orders? I want to keep promoting it but I can’t if I’m losing money. And there’s no customer service anymore, only AI going around in circles. This is my last ditch effort to get heard.

author: Anonymous_Reviewer_#1
title: Poor user experience
body:
The marketplace cannot be used properly. Repeatedly saying “duplicate listing” even though I have only ONE listing.

Update: Facebook Marketplace has become extremely frustrating and unpleasant to use. I eventually deleted my old Facebook account because Marketplace repeatedly flagged legitimate listings as duplicates, wasted my time, and still failed to help me sell items successfully. Now, after creating a newer account, I am being treated as suspicious simply because the account is less than two years old, blocked from posting in local sale groups, suspended for months by arbitrary automated rules, and asked to upload identity documents just to publish a normal local iPhone listing. This creates unnecessary privacy concerns and places an unreasonable burden on legitimate sellers, while Marketplace itself remains full of scam messages, unreliable buyers, lowballers, and suspicious accounts. The irony is that Facebook makes genuine users jump through increasingly invasive verification hoops while the actual scam problem remains obvious. I previously spent a great deal of time trying to sell devices through Marketplace and ultimately gave up and traded them in elsewhere. The platform has become so hostile to normal sellers that I no longer consider it worth using. Facebook has somehow made it harder to be a legitimate seller than to encounter a scammer.

author: Bezery
title: Warning!
body:
A WARNING TO MEMBERS, AND BUSINESS OWNERS: DO NOT PUT YOUR BUSINESS IN THE HANDS OF A PLATFORM YOU CANNOT CONTACT

After my experience with Facebook and Messenger, I would strongly caution every business owner about depending on these platforms for important contacts, customer conversations, records, or information.

My account was suspended over wording related to “Fireworks Wholesale & Retail.” We operate a legitimate business selling federally legal consumer products in the United States.

Facebook told me the suspension would last until August 26.

August 26 came and went.

My access was not restored.

There was no meaningful explanation, no clear path to resolution, and no reasonable way I could find to communicate with a human being who could actually fix the problem.

Meanwhile, years of important Messenger contacts and conversations remained inaccessible.

That should concern every business owner.

A company can spend years building relationships, communicating with customers, and developing contacts on a platform, yet one automated decision can potentially separate you or your  business from its information overnight.

Never allow Facebook, Messenger, or any other social media company to be the only place where important business information is stored.

Export your contacts. Keep independent customer records. Save important conversations and documents. Maintain your own email and phone database. Own your website and your customer relationships.

Social media should be a marketing tool. It should never become the foundation your business depends upon.

I learned that lesson the hard way. I lost my friends,and my business contacts! 

A platform that can shut the door should never be trusted or the only place where you keep the keys to your business.

title: No true privacy
body: I don’t have anything good to say whatsoever, I was being harassed and threatened by a weird couple on facebook fake pages made and lies spewed all over the site. My kids safety and privacy were taken away from me. They were contacting family members and when I made reports they did nothing I had to get restraining orders on ppl I had never met. Facebook is a joke I had to reopen my deactivated account to get pictures back but if you are ever in danger don’t expect facebook to do a thing about the fake pages are still up and so many people reported the pages they did nothing. I made my kids delete their accounts I could write a movie about how ridiculous and scary this entire situation has been on platform that uses and stores our information but don’t care enough about the people to protect their privacy and keep them safe. I reported the people and pages to IG and TikTok they instantly removed them and allowed me to lock my profile information while Facebook says that I’m not eligible. So if I could give zero stars I would.

author: Kev—O
title: Except Data Scrape
body:
I absolutely despise nice books underlying premise, which is to monitor and have files on every person on earth if possible. I do believe that this is a DARPA project that was rolled out and has been improved on in ways that we can see in ways that we can’t. I am 100% convinced that this platform records via radio and microphone, and has more data on me than my closest friends to do.   I find this absolutely atrocious, but you get what you pay for.  In an ideal world the government would outlaw anything that would provide any sort of monitoring or catalogue or tracking or cataloging my personal behavior, thoughts, posts, and forming profiles on the that are so complete that it is beyond comprehension.  I just like the government to shut off their ability to track me and those who are around me because they undoubtedly know who I spend the most time with who I come into contact with- really everything and everybody. 


Privacy concerns, and they are significant aside, I truly enjoy and appreciate all of the front facing features of the Facebook platform and find it quite useful in any number of ways. The one thing that I have a real disagreement with is their policy on firearms, we used to be able to buy and sell firearms in our area with people who we knew or at least could look up, but that is long gone.

author: TorontaFreaky
title: Fake Free Speech
body:
Used to love this app. Paid for Premium. Built my account organically. Followed the rules.
What I got instead: repeated shadowbans / temporary labels that kill reach for days at a time with zero clear explanation. No real human support. Just automated restrictions that keep coming back even when I’m not posting anything harmful.
Meanwhile the platform is full of extreme content, harassment, and accounts that openly break rules with little consequence. But a regular user who argues or gets reported by the same people can get throttled over and over.
Premium does not protect you. Customer support is basically nonexistent for this issue. The “free speech” branding feels like a joke when your account can be quietly limited and left there.
I cancelled my subscription. Looking at other platforms now. If you’re a smaller or mid-sized account that actually talks, be prepared for this exact frustration.

author: r921 Lark
title: Something valuable was lost when the long threads disappeared
body:
I have been on this platform for over nine years. I remember when long conversations could unfold over months and years, and people came to recognize one another through voice, shared history, and the way they thought out loud.

Last year I spent six months suspended for an alleged authenticity violation, filing appeals every three days and eventually writing 52 letters arguing that I was, in fact, myself.

Long threads once allowed relationships, inside jokes, and history to grow. That texture has disappeared as conversations have become fragmented and threads longer than a few hundred replies degrade quickly.

The newer features, including AI, remind me of Joni Mitchell’s parking lot.

I hope the platform finds ways to support conversations again.

title: Useful platform but needs improvement.

Useful Platform, but Needs Improvement

X remains valuable for real-time news, market analysis and connecting with people worldwide. Better moderation, fairer distribution and stronger user support would greatly improve the platform. Useful—but inconsistent. 4/5.

Many people are getting suspended, even if it is innocent like reposting or liking/commenting. When you try to appeal, you get an automatic response saying appeal denied. It is sad because in order to send the appeal in the first place, you have to prove you are human with an authenticator. Check Reddit and you will see MANY others having this issue. Twitter staff needs to do better instead of relying on AI to moderate.
